offerings.name: Reader for web search and SERP
offerings.pricing: Prototype Development: 1 Billion tokens, $50, $0.050 / 1M tokens; Production Deployment: 11 Billion tokens, $500, $0.045 / 1M tokens.
offerings.price_basis: Token usage; Jina Search Foundation API top-up
offerings.free_quota: Every new API key comes with 10M free tokens; non-commercial use only (CC-BY-NC).
offerings.output_type: Top five search results with their URLs and contents in clean, LLM-friendly text; JSON mode returns five entries with URL, title, content and timestamp if available.
